lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice recommending something for a specific audience or need.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Suggesting a museum, activity, or trip based on what someone enjoys.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Matching a recommendation to a person, situation, or limitation.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss whether a museum visit would suit a visiting friend with limited time and specific interests.

main_focus.name: audience-specific recommendation with för den som
main_focus.description: Use för den som to describe who an experience suits and under what circumstances.
model_examples: Museet passar för den som gillar design och historia.
För den som bara har en timme kan det bli lite stressigt.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use för den som naturally 2-3 times, with supporting recommendation language.

useful_chunks: För den som har begränsad tid...
Det beror på vad personen är intresserad av.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use visitor and recommendation vocabulary while keeping the scenario practical.

dialogue_shape.opening: A visitor's interests and time limit are introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They evaluate whether the activity suits the visitor, mention one limitation, and compare an alternative.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose the recommendation that best fits the need.

target_complexity.repetition: audience-specific recommendation frames should appear several times

focus: why the recommendation may or may not fit
the option chosen and the reason

sentence_focus: one sentence with för den som
one sentence recommending something under a condition
one sentence explaining what the choice depends on
